title: Он вам не Димон
summary: A Russian-language investigation by Alexei Navalny's Anti-Corruption Foundation into Dmitry Medvedev's alleged corruption network. It documents charities funding palaces, vineyards and yachts, and has English subtitles available.
why: HN cites it as a well-documented investigation into Russian elite corruption and as evidence of Navalny's influence.

quote.text: I just found an older youtube documentary created by Navalny about Medvedev [1].
